How to pay application fees
If you are a non-EU/EEA citizen, you are required to pay a 100 EUR application fee before your application is processed. Some non-EU/EEA citizens are exempt from paying application fees. Please note that the application fee is not refundable. The fee covers application for one intake.
Application submission and payment of application fee
The steps below should be followed:
Submit your online application.
Pay the application fee through the DTU Webshop
. Please use the same full name and the same email address you have entered in your application in DANS when you pay in the Webshop.
Upon successful payment, you will receive an acknowledgement confirmation from the DTU Webshop. Please check your spam folder if you have not received this. Retain the receipt of confirmation.
You may upload the payment receipt when you submit your application. Alternatively, a caseworker from DTU will contact you and re-open your application, so that you can upload the receipt confirming payment of the application fee.
When DTU registers your application fee payment, your application will be processed. The fee covers your 1st and 2nd priority programme for one intake. If you apply for multiple intakes, you have to pay the application fee for each intake.
Please note that your application will not be processed until the application fee payment has been registered at DTU.
Exemptions for non-EU/EEA citizens
If you have a “permanent residence permit” (MMF varigt ophold, MHP varigt ophold, or Permanent) or a “time limited residence permit issued with a possibility of permanent residence in Denmark” (midlertidigt ophold med mulighed for varigt ophold), you are exempted from paying the application fee. In order to qualify for this exemption, you must include a copy of your residence permit with the application. (* must have this exact wording).
Non-EU/EEA citizens who have completed a bachelor in Denmark are exempted from paying application fee.
Applicants with a “time limited residence permit”, a “Green Card” or any other Danish residence permit are required to pay the fee.
Payment - How to do the payment
DTU Webshop
Pay your application fee in DTU Webshop
.
Note that the DTU Webshop works best with the Google Chrome browser.
Please make sure to read the payment guide for the Webshop
If you do not state your full name and your email address exactly as you registered them on the application portal, we may not be able to register your payment and you may be asked to pay again. Please note that you are responsible for all fees in relation to money transfer.
